provenance_note: OMN-20866. The policy read's shape and values were recorded 2026-10-10 with a read-only gh api -i graphql call of the landing policy query against omnimarket#3538, except mergeStateStatus (recorded DIRTY, set to CLEAN) and autoMergeRequest (recorded armed, set to null), which stand for a green, unarmed PR GitHub reports mergeable now. GitHub refuses enablePullRequestAutoMerge on such a PR, so the effect sends mergePullRequest at the expected head; that response is GitHub's documented GraphQL shape, not recorded, because recording it would need a mutating call. Header values are from the recorded read.

body.query: query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $number: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { autoMergeAllowed pullRequest(number: $number) { id number headRefOid baseRefName isDraft title state merged isMergeQueueEnabled isInMergeQueue mergeStateStatus labels(first: 100) { nodes { name } } autoMergeRequest { mergeMethod } } } }

pullRequest.title: feat(OMN-16294): worktree lease node refuses a second lane in a held worktree

body.query: mutation($id: ID!, $method: PullRequestMergeMethod!, $head: GitObjectID!) { mergePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: $id, mergeMethod: $method, expectedHeadOid: $head}) { pullRequest { number merged } } }
